name: Centaur, Ixion
body:
Ixion
CR 5/MR 1

This creature has the sun-bronzed upper body of a seasoned warrior and the lower body of a sleek warhorse.

XP 1,200
N Large monstrous humanoid (mythic)
Init +2; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +7

DEFENSE

AC 21, touch 12, flat-footed 19 (+6 armor, +2 Dex, +1 dodge, +2 natural, +1 shield, –1 size)
hp 52 (5d10+25)
Fort +4, Ref +6, Will +6

OFFENSE

Speed 50 ft. (35 ft. in armor)
Melee mwk longsword +9 (1d8+4/19–20), 2 hooves +6 (1d6+2)
Ranged mwk composite longbow +7 (1d8+4/×3) or spear +6 (1d8+4/×3)
Special Attacks mythic power (1/day, surge +1d6), pounding hooves, trample (1d6+6, DC 16)MA
Space 10 ft., Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 14, Con 16, Int 11, Wis 14, Cha 12
Base Atk +5; CMB +10 (+12 overrun); CMD 22 (24 vs. overrun, 26 vs. trip)
Feats Dodge, Mobility, Multiattack, Punishing Kick B
Skills Diplomacy +5, Intimidate +6, Knowledge (nature) +4, Perception +7, Survival +9
Languages Common, Elven, Sylvan
SQ undersized weapons

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Pounding Hooves (Ex)

An ixion gains Punishing Kick, B as a bonus feat, which it can use in conjunction with its hoof attacks up to four times per day. If it hits a creature with both hoof attacks in the same round, it can use this feat without needing to expend one of its daily uses, and it can expend one use of its mythic power as a swift action to replenish its daily uses of this feat.

When a mythic centaur uses its trample, it can use Punishing Kick as a swift action at any point during its trample against a target that fails its saving throw against its trample (or waives its saving throw to make an attack of opportunity). A mythic centaur may also expend one use of its mythic power when using its trample to enable it to use Punishing Kick against all creatures that fail (or waive) their save against its trample.

Undersized Weapons (Ex)

Although a centaur is Large, its upper torso is the same size as that of a Medium humanoid. As a result, they wield weapons as if they were one size category smaller than their actual size (Medium for most centaurs).

ECOLOGY

Environment temperate forests and plains
Organization solitary, pair, band (1 mythic centaur plus 3–10 centaurs), tribe (11–30 centaurs plus 3 centaur hunters of 3rd level and 1 mythic centaur leader of 6th level)
Treasure standard (breastplate, buckler, mwk longsword, spear, mwk composite longbow (+4 Str), 20 arrows, other treasure)

Aloof with other races and at odds even with their own kind, ixions are an ancient lineage of the centaur race only slowly coming to accept the modern world. While many centaurs have become more cosmopolitan in their outlook and engaged with other races, ixions inhabit the depths of vast prairies or the fringes of eldritch forests, holding firm to the isolationist ways of their ancestors. They are sometimes considered outdated relics and shunned by other centaurs but keep their own counsel and drive away outsiders who trespass into lands they claim.

Their sometimes-violent resistance to engagement with other races leads many other races to remain wary of centaurs, keeping alive legends of territorial beastmen and the regular, violent encounters the ixions have with stubborn settlers and expansionist countries.
